subject.title: fix(ui): show workspace context in dashboard header

question: Should this workspace breadcrumb be ported into the current Dashboard header, or should persistent multi-agent/workspace context move to the alternate header/sidebar direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101017?
rationale: Current main still lacks workspace header context, but the PR is now structurally stale and another open maintainer draft changes the same breadcrumb/topbar surface, so automation cannot choose the final UI contract.

options.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Resolve the conflicts against the refactored Control UI shell and land the focused workspace breadcrumb while keeping broader UX ideas as follow-up work.

options.title: Adopt Alternate Header Direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR in favor of the no-breadcrumb/header redesign, then add persistent workspace certainty in that chosen surface.

options.title: Broaden Before Merge
options.body: Require switch feedback, reconnect/live-target proof, or quick-switch behavior before this PR can close the broader linked issue.

recommendation.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicts against the refactored Control UI shell and land the focused workspace breadcrumb while keeping broader UX ideas as follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main shell/topbar work makes steipete the best available routing owner for the current header-direction choice.
